Issue #6 requires a bounded live write smoke test in the coordinator repository before any CDW integration.
approvedScope: Create one clearly marked GitHub issue through the governed directive-to-issue path.
Apply the configured ready label as part of the issue creation flow.
Replay the same event ID to prove the coordinator does not create a duplicate issue.
constraints: This is Beta 3 test data for the coordinator repository only.
Do not merge pull requests, deploy, or invoke ChatGPT/Codex actors.
acceptanceCriteria: The first run creates one issue with the configured ready label.
The second run with the same event ID reports the event as already handled.
The write-event ledger records the created issue URL and issue number.
requiredManualTests: Inspect the created GitHub issue as live smoke-test evidence.
documentationRequirements: Report the created test artifact in the Issue #6 completion report.
exclusions: Do not implement the smoke-test issue as product work.
Do not delete audit evidence automatically.
dependencies: GitHub CLI authentication with permission to create issues in this repository.
validationRequirements: The first and replay command outputs must be captured in the completion report.
humanApprovalGates: This directive is approved only for the bounded Beta 3 live smoke test.
